_meta.schema: list of lowercase cmd.exe internal (shell builtin) command names
_meta.source: Windows Commands reference (learn.microsoft.com) — commands implemented by cmd.exe itself, not shipped as separate executables in System32
notes: Deliberately excludes external binaries that feel like builtins (whoami.exe, net.exe, tasklist.exe, certutil.exe) — those resolve to files on disk and must stay eligible for LOLBAS and path lookups.
Used to answer 'is the base command a shell builtin or something that lives on disk?', which decides whether a filepath/LOLBAS lookup is meaningful at all.
